items.evidence: Acceptance AC#1 (100 hands) passes in npm test and the 10,000-hand case passes in test:slow. The test asserts exit 0, the Options suffix, exactly one Advice line with 0 mismatches, and a count equal to the independently summed record.actions over all seats. E2E: 100113 decision points, 0 mismatches. Holdout: clean runs with count == sum of all seats' actions for seed 9 / 6-max, heads-up, sng size 4, and 9-max --lineup tough: all exit 0 with 0 mismatches.

Acceptance AC#2 passes; it asserts exit 1, the exact first-mismatch prefix and suffix with handReplayCode(42,1), the Replay line, the mismatch count >= 1, advice-determinism under Violations by invariant, and the first postflop decision found independently with runPlaytest. Holdout: a stub that varies only turn advice reports exactly the first turn decision of the run (hand, replay code, action number, describeAction text, 'recommendation.requiredEquityPct differs'), the Replay line names that code, and the invariant-violation count equals the mismatch count. A stub adding a new key reports 'recommendation.extra differs'. A throwing advise propagates.

Acceptance AC#3 passes: it checks that the later snapshot changes equityPct, then that the review recommendation is toStrictEqual to the worker hint under both plain options and options carrying the later stats. Holdout: a hand with two user decisions carrying different snapshots (flop S1, turn S2), reviewed with options carrying very different later stats: each review recommendation deep-equals the worker hint for its own snapshot; the later stats really change the turn advice; and the preflop decision without a snapshot is graded with the passed options (A-5).

Acceptance AC#4 passes in npm test (1,000 seeded variations; asserts the sampled equity method, 2 live opponents, identical views, toStrictEqual recommendation and grade, and >= 900 differing hidden deals). Holdout: an independent 4-way turn spot (sampled equity, 3-opponent snapshot) over 200 seeded deck variations of hidden cards: identical view, recommendation and grade every time, with >= 190 variations differing in other players' hole cards.

Acceptance AC#5 at 100 hands (--lineup mixed --check-styles --check-advice) passes in npm test; the 10,000-hand case passes in test:slow. E2E: two 10,000-hand --check-advice CLI runs are cmp-identical. Holdout: repeated 20-hand cash and 8-hand sng --check-styles --check-advice runs are byte-identical with equal exit codes.

Acceptance AC#6 passes: for the preflop and the flop decision, gradeDecision(structuredClone(worker hint)) is toStrictEqual to the review result and to the worker grade with the snapshot. Holdout: the same holds for two postflop decisions with distinct snapshots in one hand.

Acceptance parsing test passes (parse result, the four error cases with exit 2 and USAGE on stderr, help text, plain-vs-checked output equal after stripping). Holdout: --check-advice with sng/size parses correctly; argv order '--check-advice ... --check-styles' still echoes '--check-styles --check-advice'; duplicate, replay-code, help and '--check-advice=1' give the specified errors with exit 2 and empty stdout; --help ends with the new USAGE line. E2E: plain 10,000-hand output byte-identical to main.

Unit firstDifference passes and covers every listed case. Holdout: {} vs {} and [] vs [] are equal; root 0 vs -0 gives '(root)'; NaN vs NaN equal; null vs {} gives '(root)'; {a: undefined} vs {} gives 'a'; nested 'a[1][1]', '[0].x', 'r.m'; array vs object gives 'a'; the first difference is reported in a's key order.

Unit test passes (ascending seats, styleStats values, skipped violation and no-result hands, replaced-seat reset, deep-equal but distinct inputs). Holdout: the acting seat and zero-hand seats are excluded and VPIP is unrounded (100/3, 200/7). An advise that empties the view's legalActions and the snapshot array after use causes no mismatch over 8 decisions (16 calls), so each call gets fresh copies. Replaced seats 4 and 5 show 1 hand while the other seats show 3.

Unit decision-snapshot test passes. Holdout: an empty snapshot is stored as a distinct [] with keys view, action, observed; without a snapshot the keys are exactly view and action; the worker recommend and grade without observed equal ACTION_RANGE_ADVICE results; invalid snapshots (vpip 150, repeated seat, non-integer hands) return ok:false with RangeError for both recommend and grade; a structuredClone'd request works. (PFR > VPIP is accepted by design, per TASK-7.13 A-7.)
